about: Exam PDF name patterns, in the order the bank lists them. A PDF in exams_source_pdf/ must match one pattern (case-insensitive, <number> captured). label is the name the app shows. id_prefix starts every record id of the family and is FROZEN: the overlay, content audit, requirements, diagram masks, speech folders and saved progress are keyed by those ids, so change label freely but never id_prefix. Add a family here for another publisher or exam type (docs/ADDING_EXAMS.md).
